ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 70:30 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across visible fluke surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patch on the medial-to-distal region of the left lobe; scattered white mottling and small circular clusters on the distal portion of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped notch with an approximate convergence angle of 40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 3-8 pixels along the trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the outer edges leading to sharp distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint horizontal and diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible against the dark pigmentation of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonization at the lobe tips and minor jagged irregularities in the trailing edge contour.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant occlusion of the proximal fluke and peduncle area by high-intensity white water spray.
